propositions: Multi-project base-query loop in _build_snapshot lacks per-project error isolation; a single project's transport failure (4xx/5xx/timeout) aborts the entire reconciliation pass for all projects
Root cause of 2026-08-15 production outage: nonexistent project key LEG triggered ACLI exit 1 and blocked ~12h of scheduled Reconcile Bridge passes across all mapped projects
No partial-merge guarantee is violated: if a project's active query succeeds but done-recent query fails, partial keys from active leak into shared snapshot and are misread as deletions by the differ
Enrichment loop already implements per-project resilience via fail-open try/except; base-query loop must achieve symmetric isolation via _fetch_project helper and per-project try/except boundary
Per-project transport error must emit observable fetcher-project-fetch-failed alert with project key and pass_id, then continue processing other projects without abort
